items.q: What should you remember about **Delegate, don't do**?
items.a: **Ultimate Assistant prompt**: "send the user's query to the correct tool; never write emails or event summaries.".

items.q: What should you remember about **Specialist agents beat one mega-agent**?
items.a: **four short-prompt sub-agents (email, calendar,** contact, content) scale better than one agent with every tool.

items.q: What should you remember about **Contact lookup rule**?
items.a: **before send/draft email or calendar event with** attendee, orchestrator must call Contact Agent first and pass resolved email into the downstream query.

items.q: What should you remember about **Call n8n Workflow as Tool**?
items.a: **sub-workflows start with Execute Workflow Trigger; last** node returns response; tool names in camelCase must match system prompt (emailAgent, calendarAgent, etc.).

items.q: What should you remember about **Agent error handoff**?
items.a: **sub-workflows use "On Error**: Continue (Error Output)" → try again branch so orchestrator can retry with a new query.

items.q: What should you remember about **$fromAI for tool params**?
items.a: **model fills Gmail/Calendar node fields** (to, subject, body, message ID) from natural-language queries without manual parsing logic.

items.q: What should you remember about **ID-chaining pattern**?
items.a: **reply/label/mark-unread/delete/update require a prior "get"** tool (emails, labels, events) to fetch IDs before the action tool runs.

items.q: What should you remember about **Voice + text unified**?
items.a: **Switch routes voice → transcribe or** text → both map to json.text so one agent input field works for both.

items.q: What should you remember about **Model mix**?
items.a: **GPT-4o for orchestrator and most** sub-agents; Claude 3.5 Sonnet for Content Creator (HTML blog structure).

items.q: What should you remember about **Memory buffer**?
items.a: **orchestrator retains context ("push** it back an hour") without re-explaining prior turns.

items.q: What should you remember about **Tavily placeholders**?
items.a: **HTTP tool uses {{searchTerm}}** placeholders (same idea as $fromAI) for dynamic web search queries.
